fine_trace.code: static int tag_parse(git_tag *tag, const char *buffer, const char *buffer_end)
fine_trace.note: buffer and buffer_end are derived from the input data and its size; buffer is not guaranteed to be null-terminated at buffer_end
After parsing tag name, if the next char is not newline, tagger parsing is attempted
Tagger signature is parsed, advancing buffer past the tagger line

After tagger parse, if remaining buffer does not start with newline, strstr is used without length bounds; the code assumes strstr will stay within buffer_end but buffer may not be null-terminated there
strstr reads past buffer_end because the buffer has no null terminator, causing an out-of-bounds read
